question_en: How many parameters of the soil are checked in the soil health card?
answer_en: The soil health card checks 12 key parameters, including pH levels, organic carbon content, and macronutrients like nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium. Secondary and micronutrients may also be analyzed depending on regional requirements.
answer: मृदा स्वास्थ्य कार्ड 12 प्रमुख मापदंडों की जांच करता है, जिसमें पीएच स्तर, कार्बनिक कार्बन सामग्री और नाइट्रोजन, फॉस्फोरस और पोटेशियम जैसे मैक्रोन्यूट्रिएंट्स शामिल हैं। क्षेत्रीय आवश्यकताओं के आधार पर द्वितीयक और सूक्ष्म पोषक तत्वों का भी विश्लेषण किया जा सकता है।

retrieved.title: Soil Health Card scheme
retrieved.section: How a farmer gets the card
retrieved.text: Soil samples are collected from the farm by the state agriculture department and tested in soil testing laboratories. A printed card is given for each holding. retrieved.title: Soil Health Card scheme
retrieved.text: A National Productivity Council study (2017) found that chemical fertilizer use fell by 8-10% and crop yields rose by 5-6% after farmers followed soil health card recommendations. About 10.7 crore cards were issued in cycle I (2015-17) and 11.97 crore in cycle II (2017-19).

retrieved.text: Use 100 kg seed per hectare for bread wheat and 125 kg per hectare for durum wheat when sown on time; increase the seed rate by 25% for late sowing. A thumb rule: the 1000-seed weight in grams equals the seed rate in kg per acre. Treat seed with carboxin 1.25 g per kg, fipronil 6 g per kg or chlorpyriphos 8 ml per kg. Keep 20 cm between rows; fertilizer may be placed 2 to 3 cm deeper than the seed.

retrieved.text: Fall armyworm (FAW, Spodoptera frugiperda) is a polyphagous pest that attacks maize and many other crops. retrieved.title: Rice main-field nutrient management (transplanted rice)
retrieved.section: Leaf Colour Chart (LCC) for nitrogen timing
retrieved.text: LCC readings start at 14 days after transplanting (or 21 days after sowing for direct-seeded rice) and are repeated weekly up to heading. Use the youngest fully opened leaf (third leaf from the top), read in the morning between 8 and 10 am at 10 places in the field. The critical LCC value is 3.0 for low-nitrogen-responsive cultures such as White Ponni and 4.0 for other varieties and hybrids. If 6 out of 10 readings are below the critical value, apply 35 kg N per hectare in the dry season or 30 kg N per hectare in the wet season.

question: என் மாட்டுக்கு காய்ச்சல் இருக்கிறது, என்ன மருந்து கொடுக்கலாம்?
question_en: My cow has a fever, what medication can I give?
answer_en: You can administer paracetamol (100 mg) per day for three consecutive days, or oxytetracycline powder (30 mg) mixed with liquid feed for three days. Avoid using human medications like ibuprofen or aspirin, as they may harm cattle. How do I check if the cow is still sick after treatment? Monitor her appetite, milk yield, and behavior for 24 hours post-treatment. If symptoms persist, consult a veterinarian for further evaluation.
